items.title: Escaping the Build Trap
items.author: Melissa Perri
items.description: The definitive book on product management strategy — how to shift from output-driven feature factories to outcome-driven product organizations. Essential B2B reading.

items.title: INSPIRED: How to Create Tech Products Customers Love
items.author: Marty Cagan
items.description: The bible of modern product management. Covers everything from product vision to team structure, with strong B2B and enterprise product sections.

items.title: The Lean Startup
items.author: Eric Ries
items.description: Foundational methodology for building products iteratively. Build-Measure-Learn loops, MVP thinking, and innovation accounting directly applicable to B2B SaaS.

items.title: Crossing the Chasm
items.author: Geoffrey A. Moore
items.description: The essential B2B technology adoption framework. Explains how to transition from early adopters to mainstream enterprise customers — a must-read for any B2B PM.

items.title: Hacking Growth
items.author: Sean Ellis & Morgan Brown
items.description: Growth hacking methodologies with concrete B2B examples. Covers PLG experiments, viral loops, and retention strategies for SaaS products.

items.title: The Mom Test
items.author: Rob Fitzpatrick
items.description: Practical guide to customer conversations. Teaches how to avoid false positives in B2B customer discovery by asking questions that surface real pain points.

items.title: Product-Led Growth
items.author: Wes Bush
items.description: The playbook for building a B2B SaaS product that sells itself. Covers freemium models, free trials, product-qualified leads, and viral loops.

items.title: Continuous Discovery Habits
items.author: Teresa Torres
items.description: A structured framework for ongoing product discovery. Opportunity solution trees, interviewing techniques, and assumption mapping for B2B contexts.

items.title: Strategic Monoliths and Microservices
items.author: Vaughn Vernon & Tomasz Jaskula
items.description: Technical architecture book for PMs working with platform teams. Helps B2B PMs understand service decomposition and API strategy from a product perspective.

items.title: Sprint: How to Solve Big Problems
items.author: Jake Knapp
items.description: Google Ventures' 5-day process for solving critical business problems through prototyping and testing with customers. Highly effective for B2B enterprise product validation.

items.title: Product-Led Growth: The Definitive B2B SaaS Strategy
items.author: Lenny's Podcast / Wes Bush
items.description: Deep dive into how Slack, Calendly, and Zoom built PLG motions. Covers product-qualified leads, freemium pricing, and viral loops specific to B2B enterprise.

items.title: Marty Cagan — EMPOWERED: Ordinary Teams, Extraordinary Products
items.author: Marty Cagan (SVPG)
items.description: Marty Cagan on how to build empowered product teams in large B2B organizations. Covers the shift from project to product, team topology, and leadership behaviors.

items.title: B2B SaaS Pricing: Frameworks That Work
items.author: Kumar Madhavan
items.description: Walkthrough of usage-based, tiered, and per-seat pricing models. Includes case studies from Stripe, Twilio, and Snowflake on packaging and monetization strategy.

items.title: Jason Fried — Shape Up: Stop Running in Circles
items.author: Jason Fried (37signals / Basecamp)
items.description: Basecamp's shape-up methodology explained by the founder. Six-week cycles, appetite-based scoping, and betting tables — highly applicable to B2B product teams.

items.title: Enterprise Sales for Product Managers
items.author: Shiven Ramji (ex-Microsoft)
items.description: How B2B PMs should think about enterprise sales cycles, proof-of-concepts, RFPs, procurement, and stakeholder mapping. Real examples from Azure and Office 365.

items.title: Teresa Torres — Continuous Discovery at Scale
items.author: Teresa Torres
items.description: How to scale opportunity solution trees across multiple B2B product teams. Covers discovery cadence, cross-team alignment, and outcome-driven roadmaps.

items.title: NPS vs CSAT for B2B SaaS: Which Metric Matters?
items.author: Gainsight / Pulse Podcast
items.description: Breakdown of when to use NPS vs CSAT in B2B contexts. Covers enterprise customer health scoring, churn prediction, and survey design for low-response-rate environments.

items.title: Building a B2B Product Strategy That Actually Works
items.author: Harvard Business Review / Linda K. Gorchels
items.description: Harvard Business Review on B2B product portfolio strategy. Covers platform plays, solution bundling, and managing multi-product roadmaps in enterprise settings.

items.title: API Product Management for Platform Teams
items.author: Kin Lane (Postman)
items.description: Managing APIs as products in B2B platform organizations. Covers API design-first, developer experience, versioning strategy, and API monetization.

items.title: Don't Shave That Yak! — Product & Engineering at Google
items.author: David Wong (Google)
items.description: Talk about how Google's B2B platform teams prioritize and communicate. Lessons on saying no to scope creep and keeping enterprise products focused.

items.title: Pricing Metrics That Matter for B2B SaaS
items.author: Kyle Poyar / OpenView
items.description: Deep dive on net dollar retention (NDR), expansion MRR, time-to-value, and logo churn. Benchmarking data across hundreds of B2B SaaS companies.

items.title: SaaStr Annual
items.description: The largest B2B SaaS conference globally. Keynotes and workshops on PLG, enterprise sales, fundraising, and product strategy from founders and VCs.

items.title: Mind the Product — ProductCon
items.description: Major product management conference with strong B2B tracks. Covers product discovery, strategy, leadership, and AI in product. Workshops and networking.
items.location: London / San Francisco / Singapore / New York

items.title: Product Hunt — GLITCH Conference
items.description: Conference focused on product launches, growth, and community building. B2B track covers SaaS launches, developer products, and PLG distribution strategies.

items.title: Business of Software Conference
items.description: Long-running conference for B2B SaaS founders and product leaders. Focus on profitable growth, bootstrapping, pricing, and product strategy without VC dependency.

items.title: Reforge Huddle
items.description: Exclusive gathering for senior product and growth leaders. Deep dives on B2B retention, enterprise activation funnels, and product-led expansion. Application-based attendance.

items.title: PDMA Annual Conference — Product Development & Management Association
items.description: Academic and practitioner conference on product development. Strong B2B and industrial product track. Covers NPD processes, portfolio management, and innovation metrics.

items.title: SaaStock
items.description: European B2B SaaS conference with focus on growth, metrics, and international expansion. Strong B2B community and investor presence.

items.title: Product-Led Summit
items.description: The premier PLG conference. Sessions on product-qualified leads, freemium strategy, user onboarding, and expansion revenue. B2B SaaS focus.

items.title: Enterprise Product Summit
items.description: Niche conference for product managers working on enterprise-grade B2B products. Covers compliance, security reviews, multi-tenant architecture, and enterprise sales engineering.

items.title: Intercom — What's New Conference
items.description: Customer communication and product-led growth conference. Covers conversational support, in-app messaging, product tours, and user engagement for B2B SaaS.

items.title: Reforge — Mastering B2B Customer Discovery
items.description: In-depth training program on B2B discovery techniques. Covers stakeholder research, interview techniques, synthesis methods, and opportunity validation for enterprise products.

items.title: Product-Led Growth Certification
items.description: Comprehensive certification covering PLG fundamentals. Includes modules on freemium strategy, trial design, viral loops, and PQL scoring with B2B case studies.

items.title: B2B SaaS Pricing Certification
items.description: Structured program on value-based pricing, packaging strategy, and pricing experiments. Includes real B2B case studies from Dropbox, Figma, and Notion.

items.title: SVPG Product Masterclass
items.description: Marty Cagan and the SVPG team's intensive product management training. Covers product strategy, discovery, delivery, and team empowerment with strong B2B content.

items.title: Mind the Product — Product Leadership Program
items.description: Executive product management training for senior PMs and Heads of Product. Focus on product strategy, organizational design, and scaling B2B product organizations.

items.title: Intercom — Product-Led Growth Training
items.description: Free training on building PLG motions. Covers onboarding optimization, in-app messaging strategy, and conversion funnel analysis with hands-on exercises.

items.title: The B2B Product-Led Growth Maturity Model
items.author: OpenView / Wes Bush
items.description: A maturity framework for B2B companies adopting PLG. Covers four stages: awareness, activation, expansion, and advocacy with specific metrics and tactics per stage.

items.title: The Complete Guide to B2B SaaS Pricing and Packaging
items.author: Kyle Poyar (OpenView)
items.description: Comprehensive guide on usage-based pricing, tiered plans, per-seat vs consumption, and packaging strategy for B2B SaaS. Includes data from 300+ companies.

items.title: How to Run B2B Customer Discovery Interviews That Don't Suck
items.author: Alex Clayton
items.description: Practical template and script for B2B discovery interviews. Covers identifying power users, finding the economic buyer, and questions that reveal real budgets.

items.title: Product-Led Sales: How to Align Product and Sales Teams
items.author: First Round Review
items.description: How Atlassian, GitLab, and Datadog structure product-led sales motions. Covers PQL scoring, sales-assist signals, and when to hand off from product to sales.

items.title: B2B Product Roadmap Prioritization for Enterprise Accounts
items.author: Maggie Crowley (Drift/PagerDuty)
items.description: How to handle multi-tenant feature requests, enterprise deal-driven roadmaps, and balancing top-down strategy with bottom-up customer needs. Includes ICE and RICE adaptations for B2B.

items.title: The API Product Manager's Guide to Platform Strategy
items.author: Kin Lane
items.description: Guide to managing APIs as products in B2B platform companies. Covers developer portals, API versioning, deprecation strategies, and developer relations.

items.title: Designing B2B Onboarding That Proves Value in 30 Days
items.author: Lincoln Murphy / Sixteen Ventures
items.description: Time-to-value framework for B2B SaaS. Covers adoption milestones, success plans, and how product can reduce time-to-first-value through in-app guidance.

items.title: B2B Churn Analysis: Causes, Metrics, and Prevention
items.author: Christoph Janz / Point Nine Capital
items.description: Deep analysis of why B2B companies churn. Covers logo churn vs. dollar churn, multi-threading risk, and build vs. buy triggers in enterprise procurement.

items.title: B2B Competitive Differentiation Without Feature Parity
items.author: April Dunford
items.description: Positioning strategy for B2B products that can't out-feature incumbents. Covers market context, alternative-based positioning, and the value wedge framework.

items.title: B2B Buyer Persona Research: Building ICPs That Drive Product Decisions
items.author: Michele Hansen
items.description: Method for creating B2B ideal customer profiles based on qualitative research. Covers job-to-be-done interviews, persona segmentation, and persona-driven validation.

items.title: Lenny's Podcast — B2B PLG with Rachbot Founder
items.description: In-depth interview with Rachbot founder on building a product-led B2B sales tool. Covers pricing experiments, sales-assist triggers, and navigating enterprise procurement.

items.title: Product Thinking — Marty Cagan on B2B Product Strategy
items.description: Marty Cagan discusses how B2B product strategy differs from B2C, the importance of empowered product teams in enterprise, and why most B2B product roadmaps fail.

items.title: B2B Product Chat — Enterprise SaaS Metrics
items.description: Weekly podcast dedicated to B2B product management. Covers NDR deep dives, pricing case studies, sales alignment, and interviews with B2B product leaders from GitLab, Datadog, and Snowflake.

items.title: This is Product Management — B2B Edition
items.description: Interviews with product leaders from top B2B companies. Topics include product-led sales, API product management, developer experience, and enterprise customer success.

items.title: The Product-Led Growth Podcast
items.description: Dedicated to product-led growth strategies. B2B-heavy content including episodes on free trial optimization, PQL scoring algorithms, and expansion revenue strategies.

items.title: Hidden Brain — The Psychology of B2B Buying Decisions
items.description: Exploration of the psychological biases and social dynamics behind enterprise purchasing decisions. Relevant for PMs designing B2B products that need to win internal champions.

items.title: Category Pirates — Creating New B2B Markets
items.description: Podcast about creating new market categories. B2B focus with episodes on category design, market creation, and how companies like Salesforce and Slack created new enterprise categories.

items.title: SaaStr Podcast — B2B Pricing Breakdowns
items.description: Weekly deep dives into B2B SaaS pricing strategies. Real numbers from public companies, pricing model analysis, and lessons from pricing failures.

items.title: Acquired — B2B Platform Deep Dives
items.description: Deep-dive episodes on the history and strategy behind major B2B platforms including Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, and Atlassian. Essential listening for B2B PMs.

items.title: The Product Experience — B2B Product Decisions
items.description: Weekly product management podcast with B2B-focused episodes on feature prioritization, stakeholder management, enterprise UX, and product analytics in B2B contexts.

items.title: The Product-Led B2B Pricing Playbook
items.body: You are a B2B SaaS pricing strategist. Analyze the following product and suggest a pricing model (usage-based, tiered, per-seat, or hybrid), propose 3 tiers with features, and estimate packaging value. Product: [describe product]. Target market: [enterprise size + vertical]. Current pricing: [if any].

items.title: Enterprise Stakeholder Mapping
items.body: You are a B2B product strategist mapping decision-makers for an enterprise sale. List all potential stakeholders involved in a [product] purchase at a [company size] organization. For each: role, influence level (decision-maker/influencer/champion/detractor), primary concern, and what 'good' looks like to them. Then rank by power and interest.

items.title: B2B Roadmap Communication Draft
items.body: You are drafting a B2B product roadmap update for enterprise customers. Write a quarterly roadmap communication for [product name] to be sent to [audience: executives/champions/end users]. Include: recent wins, upcoming features, deprecation plan, and how customer feedback shaped decisions. Tone: [confident/empathetic/technical]. Length: [brief/detailed].

items.title: Opportunity Solution Tree for B2B Pain Point
items.body: You are Teresa Torres' framework applied to a B2B problem. Build an opportunity solution tree for: [describe B2B pain point]. Start with the desired outcome, branch into opportunities (gaps in current experience), then solution ideas for each opportunity. Include assumptions to test and experiment ideas for the top 3 solutions.

items.title: B2B Feature Prioritization with Weighted Scoring
items.body: You are evaluating B2B feature requests using a weighted scoring framework. Score each of these [features] against: revenue impact (0-5), customer demand (0-5), engineering effort inverse (0-5), strategic fit (0-5), competitive urgency (0-5). Weight each dimension and calculate total. Recommend a priority order. Features: [list].

items.title: Design a B2B Dogfooding Program
items.body: Design a dogfooding program for [product], a B2B SaaS tool. Include: participant selection criteria (roles, departments), onboarding flow, feedback collection mechanism, success metrics (time-to-value, NPS, usage frequency), duration, and criteria for 'graduation' to external beta. Output as a playbook document.

items.title: B2B Churn Root Cause Analysis
items.body: You are analyzing B2B customer churn for [product]. Given the following data: [list churned accounts with: segment, usage metrics, support tickets, CSAT, contract value]. Identify top 3 churn patterns, for each: root cause, leading indicators, and product changes that could prevent it. Provide a prioritized action plan.

items.title: Design a Product-Led Growth Motion for B2B
items.body: You are designing a PLG motion for [product], a B2B SaaS aimed at [target segment]. Outline: (1) free tier features and limits, (2) activation milestone definitions, (3) PQL definition and scoring, (4) sales-assist triggers and handoff process, (5) conversion tactics (upsell prompts, trial expiration). Estimate conversion rate targets for each stage.

items.title: B2B API Product Specification Template
items.body: Write a product specification for a new [API/feature] for [platform]. Include: (1) developer use case and persona, (2) endpoint design with request/response examples, (3) rate limiting and SLA commitment, (4) documentation requirements, (5) deprecation and versioning policy, (6) migration guide for existing users. Output as a product spec document.

items.title: B2B Competitive Battle Card Generator
items.body: Create a competitive battle card for [product] vs [competitor]. Include: (1) positioning statement, (2) feature comparison table, (3) common objections and rebuttals, (4) pricing comparison, (5) ideal replacement scenarios, (6) customer proof points. Format as a one-pager for the sales team. Competitor weaknesses should be factual, not exaggerated.

items.title: B2B Customer Discovery
items.description: Conducting effective customer interviews and discovery sessions with B2B stakeholders. Includes gatekeeper navigation, multi-threaded discovery, and uncovering hidden pain points.
items.body: Ability to plan and execute structured discovery conversations with multiple stakeholders in a B2B buying process. Includes stakeholder mapping, question design, active listening, and synthesis into opportunity areas. Key skill for validating product-market fit in enterprise contexts.

items.title: B2B Pricing Strategy
items.description: Designing and iterating pricing models for B2B SaaS products. Covers willingness-to-pay research, packaging, tiering, usage-based vs per-seat models, and discount governance.
items.body: Skill in determining optimal pricing and packaging for B2B products. Includes value-based pricing methodologies, competitive benchmarking, packaging design (features per tier), understanding elasticity, and managing pricing changes without churn.

items.title: Enterprise Roadmapping
items.description: Creating and communicating multi-quarter product roadmaps that balance strategic vision with enterprise customer commitments. Includes theme-based vs feature-based roadmaps.
items.body: The ability to build and maintain product roadmaps that satisfy both internal strategy and external enterprise account needs. Covers roadmap levels (strategic vs committed), managing deal-driven roadmap items, deprecation planning, and communicating trade-offs to executive stakeholders.

items.title: B2B Stakeholder Management
items.description: Navigating complex stakeholder relationships across enterprise accounts. Includes managing multiple buyers, handling escalation, and building executive relationships.
items.body: Skill in identifying and managing relationships with all parties in an enterprise buying process: economic buyers, technical evaluators, end users, procurement, and legal. Includes executive communication, escalation management, and building champion networks within accounts.

items.title: Product-Led Sales
items.description: Designing product experiences that generate and qualify leads. Includes PQL design, freemium/free trial strategy, in-app upsell, and sales-assist trigger definition.
items.body: Ability to design product-led growth motions that generate, qualify, and convert leads without traditional sales. Includes defining product-qualified leads (PQLs), designing self-serve onboarding, setting up trial-to-paid conversion paths, and managing sales-assist handoffs.

items.title: B2B Metrics & Analytics
items.description: Selecting and tracking the right metrics for B2B SaaS products. Covers NDR, ARR, logo churn, expansion MRR, time-to-value, and cohort analysis.
items.body: Skill in defining and monitoring key B2B SaaS metrics that drive product decisions. Includes understanding net dollar retention vs logo retention, expansion revenue drivers, cohort-based retention analysis, and building dashboards that differentiate between usage, engagement, and business metrics.

items.title: B2B Partnership & Ecosystem Strategy
items.description: Building and managing ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and platform ecosystems. Includes API partnerships, marketplace strategy, and co-selling motions.
items.body: Ability to identify, negotiate, and maintain strategic partnerships that extend a B2B product's reach. Includes building integration marketplaces, managing co-sell relationships, defining API partnership tiers, and measuring partner-sourced revenue.

items.title: B2B Compliance & Security Knowledge
items.description: Understanding enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and translating them into product decisions. Includes security review support and vendor assessment navigation.
items.body: Working knowledge of enterprise compliance frameworks that affect product design and go-to-market. Includes understanding SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP requirements and how they impact feature development, data architecture, and deployment options.

items.title: Platform Product Management
items.description: Managing internal platforms, APIs, and infrastructure as products for internal and external developers. Includes developer experience, versioning, and platform ROI.
items.body: Skill in treating platforms, APIs, and internal tools as first-class products with their own user personas (developers), OKRs, and roadmaps. Includes API-first design, developer portal management, deprecation strategy, and measuring platform adoption and developer satisfaction.

items.title: Continuous B2B Discovery
items.description: Running ongoing product discovery in B2B contexts with long sales cycles and small user bases. Includes opportunity solution trees, assumption mapping, and low-fidelity prototyping for enterprise.
items.body: Ability to maintain a continuous discovery cadence despite the challenges of B2B (fewer users, longer sales cycles, harder access to decision-makers). Includes adapting Teresa Torres' framework for B2B, using design sprints for enterprise validation, and balancing discovery with delivery in resource-constrained teams.

items.title: Productboard
items.description: Product management platform focused on B2B insight collection, prioritization, and roadmapping with customer portal. Strong integrations with Salesforce, Jira, and Zendesk.

items.title: Amplitude
items.description: Product analytics platform for understanding B2B user behavior. Behavioral cohorts, funnel analysis, retention curves, and feature adoption tracking for enterprise products.

items.title: Pendo
items.description: Product adoption and digital adoption platform. In-app guides, NPS surveys, and feature engagement analytics. Strong B2B enterprise feature set including multi-product views.

items.title: Stripe Billing
items.description: B2B subscription management and billing platform. Supports usage-based pricing, tiered plans, invoicing, and revenue recognition. Essential for any B2B SaaS product.

items.title: Hotjar
items.description: Experience analytics tool with session recordings, heatmaps, and surveys. Useful for B2B user research and understanding how enterprise users interact with complex interfaces.

items.title: LaunchDarkly
items.description: Feature management platform for B2B products. Gradual rollouts, A/B testing, targeting by customer segment, and kill switches for enterprise reliability.

items.title: Linear
items.description: Issue tracking and project management for product teams. Keyboard-first, fast, and developer-friendly. Strong API for automation and integrations with GitHub/GitLab.

items.title: Retool
items.description: Low-code platform for building internal B2B tools. Connect to any database or API to create admin panels, customer dashboards, and internal CRUD apps quickly.

items.title: Canny
items.description: Customer feedback management platform for B2B. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests with public or private roadmaps. Integrates with Intercom, Zendesk, and Slack.

items.title: Segment (Twilio Segment)
items.description: Customer data platform for B2B. Collect, unify, and route customer data across analytics, marketing, and product tools. Essential for building a single view of the enterprise customer.
